cmd: R=/opt/weather-pipeline/repo; git -C $R remote -v | sed "s#//[^@]*@#//***@#" | head -2; git -C $R status -sb | head -3; git -C $R config user.name; git -C $R config user.email; ls $R/data | head -3; ls $R/data/charts 2>&1 | head -2; grep -c . /opt/weather-pipeline/repo/.env; cut -d= -f1 $R/.env | sort | tr "\n" " " | head -c 600; echo; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "raw_http=%{http_code} ct=%{content_type}\n" https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/main/data/anim/fog.png; echo GIT_DONE
